== Documentation ==
The documentation comments for this script come from the <code>DefaultDisableHavokOnLoad.psc</code> source file.

<source>
Disable havok on a ref OnLoad(), then optionally enable havok OnHit(), OnActivate(), or OnGrab()
</source>
